messages:
maya: quick ask — running a 15:30 PT demo that needs 2x A100s (short, ~20m) in us-west2. Can someone lock a reservation or confirm quota? also want to run the runtime v2 canary (PR #412) against the same pool. @kevin you cool with canary?

kevin: can do a quick check. are you fine if we reserve a tiny `gcloud` reservation for the window or do you want a dedicated pool slot?

maya: reservation is fine, cheaper. if quota exists, prefer reservation + label so it doesn't affect other tenants. tag can be `demo/maya-15-30`.

kevin: checking quota now. pinging billing/account team if we need to bump. give me 5m.

ops-bot: Deploy window notice: reminder to file a quick rollback plan for canaries > 10% traffic. See `#eng-oncall` for runbook. :information_source:

cloud-partner-bot: vendor status: us-west2 A100 pool currently has 8 available. Preemptible/spot mix active. Recommended: create reservation to guarantee capacity for 15:00-16:00. Reply `CONFIRM` to proceed with reservation API.

liam: re: fallback — if reservation fails, we can spin up 2x h100-preemptible in us-west1 and throttle to demo limits. Not ideal for latency but quick fallback.

kevin: vendor says - we need to submit reservation by 14:50 PT to be safe. maya, confirm and i'll run the reservation command.

maya: CONFIRM. go ahead. also i'll tag the canary PR with `canary/demo-15-30` so it's clear.

kevin: running reservation now. command i'm using: 
```
gcloud compute reservations create rsv-demo-maya-15-30 \
  --zone=us-west2-a --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator=count=2,type=nvidia-tesla-a100 --project=redwood-inference-demo --labels=demo=maya
```

kevin: done — reservation created, ID `rsv-demo-maya-15-30`, shows as ACTIVE. Vendor telemetry indicates both GPUs attached. :white_check_mark:

maya: awesome, thanks!!! i'll kick off the canary at 15:05 PT and run smoke tests.

liam: i'll be on standby from 14:45 PT in case anything flaps. if the canary degrades perf, revert to previous runtime and re-route to hosted pool.

maria: (just jumping in) FYI if billing spikes we might exceed demo budget; tagging finance with a heads-up. :money_with_wings:

kevin: noted — reservation is within demo allowances per the billing tag. i'll post the reservation ID in the demo runbook.

maya: perfect. thanks all — will report back after smoke. :rocket:
